title: Pirate hotspots, then and now
excerpt: I mapped 7,511 pirate attacks from 1993 to 2020 and followed the hotspots as they moved, from the Strait of Malacca to Somalia and the Gulf of Guinea. In 2025 the busiest pirate waters were the Singapore Strait, and in 2026 Somali hijackers are back.
seo_description: 7,511 pirate attacks mapped, 1993 to 2020, with IMB counts to 2026: how piracy moved from Malacca to Somalia, West Africa and Singapore.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Pirate hotspots, then and now' in black and red on pale paper, above three small world maps for 1993 to 1999, 2008 to 2011 and 2016 to 2020 with attacks shown as orange and red hexagons: clustered in Southeast Asia, then around Somalia and the Gulf of Aden, then off West Africa. Text: 7,511 attacks mapped; Somali waters peaked at 231 attacks in 2011; the Singapore Strait had 80 incidents in 2025.
